intro_html: Walk beneath the legendary North Face of the Eiger on this famous and relatively easy trail. Stunning views of the Swiss Alps' most iconic rock wall. This descent hike from Eigergletscher to Alpiglen is a must-do for anyone visiting the Jungfrau region.

routes.title_html: Eigergletscher → Alpiglen — Beneath the North Face — Descend the stunning switchback trail beneath the legendary Eiger North Face with unobstructed views of this 1800 m rock wall. Well-maintained path through alpine meadows and rocky terrain.

getting_there.by_pt_html: Train + Cog Railway: From Interlaken Ost, take the scenic railway to Grindelwald (~35 min). From Grindelwald station, follow signs to the Jungfraubahn terminal. Take the Jungfraubahn (cog railway) uphill toward Jungfraujoch; alight at Eigergletscher station (~40 min from Grindelwald). Swiss Travel Pass accepted on rail; Jungfraubahn requires additional ticket (CHF 50–70). Return via cable car from Alpiglen to Grindelwald (CHF 15) or hike down further.
getting_there.by_car_html: Via Grindelwald: From Interlaken, drive north to Grindelwald (19 km, ~25 min on scenic mountain road). Park at the Grindelwald terminal parking (CHF 3/h) near Jungfraubahn station. Take the cog railway to Eigergletscher (see transit details above). Alternatively, park lower in Grindelwald and use the Alpiglen cable car for return descent to Grindelwald village.

lapse_rate.valley_ref: Interlaken (570 m) — reference station for Bernese Oberland

weather.season_html: June–September is peak season; July–August warmest but often crowded. Avoid after fresh snow or during afternoon thunderstorms.

reports.title: Eiger Trail — Descent beneath the North Face
bullets_html: • North Face views spectacular; stop for photos often
• Eigersee glacial lake is photogenic rest point

reports.title: Eigergletscher to Alpiglen with perfect views
bullets_html: • Cog railway efficient; don't miss Eigergletscher station
• Cable car from Alpiglen saves 1h if legs tired

gear.title: Essential
items_html:
• Hiking poles
  • Sun protection (cream + glasses + hat)
  • 2 L water
  • Emergency snacks

safety_html: Turn back if thunderstorms develop — lightning risk above treeline is extreme.
resources_html: SAC Route Portal — Eiger Trail
disclaimer_html: This page is an informal hike plan, not professional mountain-safety advice. Conditions change rapidly. Always check MeteoSwiss and SAC before setting out.
